verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a full custom-rules engine supporting risk score thresholds, transaction attributes, value/list matching, and allow/block/review outcomes (docs-3, docs-10, docs-14, docs-17, docs-23, docs-11/18/24), plus rule reference and risk-setting controls (docs-13, docs-25). However, explicit velocity-counter attributes aren't directly evidenced, and community reports note limited programmatic control and friction enabling Allow Rules (comm-2, comm-7). missing for 10: explicit velocity-counter rule attributes, independent hands-on confirmation of full rule flexibility beyond documented examples.
